work.summary: Meta Empires is a studio building AI products for business workflows. I co-founded it and lead engineering on [Hala AI](/projects/hala-ai/).
responsibilities: Lead engineering on Hala AI, a real-time voice and text conversational-AI platform across WhatsApp, Instagram and web voice channels, designed for multi-tenant scale.
contributions: Engineered a low-latency voice pipeline in Python and FastAPI with real-time LLM interaction and a dialect-aware speech-to-text and text-to-speech path supporting 20+ languages and native Arabic dialects.

Architected a multi-tenant TypeScript and Python codebase with workspace-level isolation, encrypted tenant credentials and usage-based billing.

work.summary: Client integrations and the Linux infrastructure they run on, from implementation through incident response and handover.
